episodes.synopsis: Mihashi a freshman in high-school, and has just transferred to Nishiura High, a school not known for its baseball. But after he gets forced into playing by its new female coach, he befriends the the catcher Abe, who becomes his main supporter in the future.
episodes.title: True Ace

episodes.synopsis: The baseball team at Nishiura High heads out to a training camp. As everyone is preparing for their first practice match against Mihashi's old school, Abe realizes that the catcher's role is not just on the field but is also to encourage and to protected the pitcher and his well-being.
episodes.title: A Catcher’s Role

episodes.synopsis: The practice game between Nishiura High and Mihoshi, Mihashi's old school, is about to start. However before the game starts Mihashi loses his confidence and runs behind the club building, Hatake, the catcher from Mihoshi, followed him and begins to harassing him to the point of threatening to break his arm for the lost games in middle-school.
episodes.title: Practice Match

episodes.synopsis: Mihashi is pitching nicely, outing all of Mihoshi’s batters so far. At the top of the 2nd inning, Tajima easily hits Kanou’s forkball. Kanai tries to compete with Tajima and do the same, but strikes out instead.
episodes.title: Play

episodes.synopsis: With nice team work, Nishiura is able to score two consecutive runs easily. Meanwhile, tension is rising between Kanou and the rest of his team.
episodes.title: Don't Ease Up!

episodes.synopsis: Going into the bottom of the 7th inning, Kanou finally goes into detail about how great Mihashi’s control really is, and Mihoshi’s substitute coach comes up with a plan.
episodes.title: The Requirements to be a Pitcher

episodes.synopsis: Through good teamwork, Nishiura was able to rally and gain back the lead. After winning the game, Mihashi’s old teammates finally acknowledge their mistakes and ask for his forgiveness and to come back.
episodes.title: I Want to Play Baseball!

episodes.synopsis: On the way to practice, Mihashi meets Sakaeguchi and learns about how in the Senior League, Abe was teamed up with an “amazing pitcher.”
episodes.title: Amazing Pitcher?

episodes.synopsis: Abe’s past relationship with Haruna is revealed, showing the circumstances that led Abe to consider Haruna to be the worst pitcher instead of one of the best.
episodes.title: Past

episodes.synopsis: In order to be able to play two practice games, everyone on the team must be able to play at least two different positions.
episodes.title: Steadily

episodes.synopsis: The Summer National Senior High School Baseball Championship Saitama Tournament is about to start. All in all, 170 schools in the area gathered together in order to draw lots to determine who they would be playing against.
episodes.title: Summer Is Starting

episodes.synopsis: During practice, the team, with the addition of Hamada, continue to meditate, but this time start to actively train their relaxing reflex to trigger with the presence of a third base runner.
episodes.title: Cheering Party

episodes.synopsis: The team has been working hard to prepare for the game against Tosei, to the point that even Shinooka-chan collapses from exhaustion because she had pulled an all-nighter writing a detailed report on Tosei’s battery and batters.
episodes.title: Summer Game Beginning

episodes.synopsis: The first game of the summer tournament begins. Everyone is present, including the big crowd that Hamada got to come to the game.
episodes.title: Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: The Tosei batters are getting perplexed by Mihashi’s pitching since the balls appear to be easy, but are hard to connect.
episodes.title: First Point

episodes.synopsis: Tosei still does not know what to make of Mihashi’s pitches, and Nishiura is still hanging on. Nishiura had a chance to get another run in, but the Tosei battery once again made Tajima strike out.
episodes.title: Do Not Underestimate

episodes.synopsis: Tosei comes back with a counter attack plan, playing to the basics and hitting grounders. Though Nishiura is still hanging onto their lead, they are playing really hard defense.
episodes.title: Third Runner

episodes.synopsis: After getting on base because of a dead ball caused by the rain, Mihashi and the rest of his team work hard in order to get one more run before the inning ends.
episodes.title: Additional Point

episodes.synopsis: Tosei continue their attack plan, concentrating on hitting Mihashi’s curveball, and manage to get in one run. Nishiura gets into a little mishap, because Mihashi gets a nose bleed, making Abe worry about Mihashi’s condition and whether or not he can pitch.
episodes.title: Tosei's Abilities

episodes.synopsis: Though Nishiura is playing a good defense, the lucky breaks that Tosei keep on having make the members of Nishiura seem clumsy.
episodes.title: Reversal

episodes.synopsis: Tajima once again strikes out, but is able to help his teammates successfully steal bases once he enters the coaching box again.
episodes.title: One More Point

episodes.synopsis: Tosei takes several gamble plays and is able to get one more run in to take the lead once again.
episodes.title: Defend!

episodes.synopsis: Nishiura is desperate now to get their batters onto the plates in order to have a chance at winning.
episodes.title: Strictly

episodes.synopsis: Now that they have the lead, Nishiura must make sure that they don’t allow any more runs.
episodes.title: Conclusion

episodes.synopsis: After the game against Tosei ends, Mihashi is taken home to rest since he has a fever.
episodes.title: One Victory
